recipes.name: Umeshu soda
recipes.method: Fill a tall glass with ice, pour in the umeshu and top up with soda. Stir once from the bottom.

recipes.name: Lemon sour
recipes.method: Fill a tall glass with ice and lemon slices. Add the shochu and lemon juice, top up with soda and stir once.

recipes.name: Yuzu highball
recipes.method: Fill a tall glass with ice and stir the whisky until it's well chilled. Top up with soda, stir once, then twist the peel over the glass.

recipes.name: Mizuwari
recipes.method: Fill a glass with ice and stir to chill it. Pour off any water, add the whisky and stir thirteen and a half times. Add the cold water and stir three and a half times more.

recipes.name: Midori sour
recipes.method: Shake the Midori, vodka and citrus with ice. Strain over fresh ice and top up with a splash of soda.
